title: Traffic Congestion and Logistical Delays
content: Handling logistical delays in the supply chain due to traffic. When traffic congestion is severe (due to VIP movement, construction, or accidents), expect 12-24 hour delays in fresh stock arrivals. Action: Deprioritize promotions on highly perishable goods until supply normalizes. Communicate potential stockouts to loyal customers.

title: Supplier Delays and Raw Material Shortages
content: Handling raw material shortages or supplier factory issues. When a supplier delay is confirmed, immediately ration fast-moving goods to prevent hoarding. Action: Identify alternative local distributors to bridge the gap. Warn customers via WhatsApp about temporary shortages of specific brands.
